title: Door-to-door paving crew wants deposit today for unscheduled work

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Afternoon ma'am, Premier Paving. We just finished a driveway on your street and have leftover asphalt. We can do yours today only for three thousand, half off.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: The driveway does have cracks. But my roofer is coming next week.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: This is separate. Price is good until five pm today because the truck leaves tonight. We need the three thousand deposit by bank transfer now to hold the material, then we schedule the crew.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: So you would come back another day for the work?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Right, we schedule after the deposit clears. Today only.

review_note: signals_required. ACH to a new payee under 3x baseline. No written estimate, no scheduled date, deposit demanded today. Only urgency plus new payee (H-04) can hold it. Weakest coverage in the suite.
